card.name: Use-by time after preparing a solution
card.fires_on: The word "within" (or a similar timing word like "immediately") right after a verb such as use, administer or take, in directions about how long a prepared or diluted product stays usable.

modes.label: within + time limit
modes.description: "within" after use, administer or take, introducing a time limit after preparation.
modes.example: Use the MACRILEN solution<< within>> 30 minutes after preparation.

modes.label: immediate administration
modes.description: A timing word like "immediately" or "from" after giving a prepared mixture.
modes.example: administer the suspension or the mixture<< immediately>>.

card.writes: It promotes a few unrelated tokens, so there is no clear output effect beyond a time expression following.
card.plain: It marks the word that begins a deadline for using a medicine after it has been mixed or diluted.
